title: Guided Highlights Tour of Grace Cathedral in San Francisco
includes: Stories and expert knowledge will be provided by our official guides.
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore the stunning architecture and rich history of Grace Cathedral, San Francisco's premier Gothic structure, on a Guided Highlights tour. Marvel at intricate stained-glass windows and renowned artworks, including Ghiberti’s "Gates of Paradise" and Keith Haring's alter piece. Delve into the cathedral's significant role in social justice and reflect on the city's resilience following the 1906 earthquake. Complete your tour with a serene walk through one of the cathedral's labyrinths, offering a moment of contemplation amidst the historic beauty.

- Discover the architectural splendor of Grace Cathedral in San Francisco
- View iconic artworks, including Ghiberti’s Gates of Paradise
- Learn about the cathedral's history and social justice initiatives
- Enjoy a peaceful walk through one of the labyrinths at the end of the tour
